notes: Reproduces the paper's SMR/AER risk-quantification arithmetic (section 6.3, lines ~618-797) unmodified: a multi-way PROC SUMMARY (CLASS/TYPES/OUTPUT) that aggregates observed severe-infection hospitalisations, population-expected counts and person-years overall and per risk factor, a SELECT/WHEN block that labels each aggregate row by its risk factor, then the standardised morbidity ratio (SMR), absolute excess risk per 10,000 person-years (AER) and exact Poisson (chi-square-based) 95% confidence interval formulas. Scaled down from the original's ~25 risk factors to two (sex, typeg) and driven by a small mock 8-row aggregate table standing in for 'shr_aer_inf_grave' (built upstream in the original program from the protected FCCSS/BCCSS patient extracts). No syntax adaptations were needed for this bundle.
